verdict: PERTURBATIONAL EDGES TRANSFER, AND THEY CARRY A SIGN. K562 edges move their targets 1.31x more in RPE1 than pairs matched on RPE1 perturbation strength x gene responsiveness (p 0). Direction agrees 67.2% against 52.2% when the source is swapped for another perturbation of matched strength -- an edge-specific increment of +15.0 points, rising to +31.4 on the RPE1 |z| >= 2 subset (82.5% vs 51.1%). The raw 0.5 comparison is not the null: a shared stress and proliferation axis already pushes agreement to 52.2% with no edge at all. Sign is what the curated layer lacks on 91.2% of its edges and what the benchmark ladder cannot reach.
